intent: new concept using R01 only as style reference
tool_prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independent production concept reference for original warehouse digital twin 3D models.
Style: beautiful original boxy cartoon low-poly miniature. Strong cuboid primary masses, planar flat-shaded faces, small single-step bevels, matte surfaces. Tangible thickness, coherent connected construction, depth from clean silhouettes and gentle contact shadows. Charcoal #293D46, petrol teal #2E7376, warm tan #C99A60 and warm off-white environment palette. Clean blue/orange/purple/green/yellow uniforms reserved for people. Neutral light grey studio background, soft even light. Functional simplicity with carefully designed proportions. Avoid realistic textures, weathering, tiny bolts, smooth organic characters, thin stretched parts, floating disconnected components, extra limbs and visual clutter. No copyrighted characters or brands.

Primary request: a spacious production reference sheet with five equally readable labelled storage designs, each with a large three-quarter view and smaller structural front/side inset. Labels exactly SMALL, STANDARD, HEAVY, LONG, FLEX. SMALL: low compact shelving with several open small bins. STANDARD: medium-height modular shelf rack with three substantial usable levels, varied carton silhouettes. HEAVY: low reinforced ground pallet position with fork-access feet and one strapped pallet load. LONG: cantilever rack with three well-separated sturdy support posts supporting long profiles along their length. FLEX: clearly finite marked transfer bay with removable low supports, its own footprint, not an unlimited storage area. Show believable side/rear connections, thick shelves and stable feet; generous practical aisle access; include one separate blocky1.70m scale worker. Five types remain visibly distinct in silhouette. Engineering dimensions will be supplied separately; avoid invented numeric dimensions.

Input image 1 is the accepted R01 style board, supplied only as a style/palette/material reference, not an edit target. Create a NEW five-type storage sheet; do not reproduce the R01 scene or title. Use a wide layout with enough space for all five main views and their smaller structural insets to remain legible. The insets show the same designs as their corresponding main views.
review: All five exact labels SMALL, STANDARD, HEAVY, LONG, FLEX are visible with quarter-view models and corresponding front/side structural insets.
SMALL shows low two-level shelving and open bins; STANDARD has three substantial decks with four grounded uprights and varied cartons.
HEAVY shows strapped cargo on a reinforced low support with visible fork openings and grounded feet.
LONG shows three separate grounded posts and repeated cantilever arms supporting long profiles at three elevations; side inset exposes the cantilever construction.
FLEX shows a finite marked footprint, open front, perimeter protection and three separate removable low supports.
R01 cuboid style, planar faces, small bevels and charcoal/petrol/tan palette match; no missing family or materially disconnected/floating support observed.
limitations: Concept art and insets are not engineering dimensions, payload capacities or proof of structural strength.
The sole 1.70m figure is a scale/style cue; final storage dimensions and accessibility come from V3 layout/cargo proposals.
No geometry or runtime acceptance is implied; root must inspect the saved PNG before R02 PASS.
